settings.title: What if I don't like my 3D design?
settings.content:
No worries at all! If you're not fully satisfied with your 3D design yet, we're happy to adjust it based on your feedbacks until it meets your highest expectation—at no additional cost.
Additionally, if you decide not to continue with the project after reviewing the 3D design—though this rarely happens—we do offer a Refund Policy for your peace of mind!

settings.title: Do I need to pay before seeing the 3D design?
settings.content: Yes, but not the full amount. Only a minimum deposit is required to ensure we’re all set to complete your project. Once the deposit is paid, the project is proceeded right away then!

settings.title: How much is the deposit to start my order?
settings.content:
You can pay in 2 installments: the first half to start the order, and the other half when the product is completed or whenever you're financially comfortable!
If that doesn't work for you, we offer more flexible payment plans, allowing you split into 3 or 4 installments for your convenience!

settings.title: How can I place an order?
settings.content: By clicking "CONTACT SALES" above and sending your photos via direct message. We'll review them, give an exact price, and even suggest some lovely ideas you might love!

settings.title: Secure payment methods?
settings.content:
US: Apple Pay, PayPal, Card, Zelle, CashApp
UK: Apple Pay, PayPal, Card, Bank-Transfer
EU: Apple Pay, PayPal, Card, IBAN, iDEAL

settings.title: Item details:
settings.content:
- Made by: ifaceusa.com(since 2023).
- Based in the US and UK. Full info at About us.
-️ Materials: Soybean-based plastic, solid and durable.
- Acrylic colors.
- Size: 8 inches.

Turn-around time: 7-15 business days.
*If your picture includes some complicated details, the turn-around time could take longer.

settings.title: Delivery and Refund & Return:
settings.content:
Shipping:
- US shipping time: 6-10 business days
- UK-EU shipping time: 6-8 business days

Shipping insurance: If you receive the product damaged, we provide a FREE replacement.

Refunds & Returns are available at Policy.

settings.title: Warranty(up to 5 years):
settings.content:
3-year warranty: If the arts got any problems itself, we provide a FREE replacement.

You can upgrade it longer at 5-Year warranty program. This action costs NO EXTRA.

settings.title: What if I don't like my 3D design?
settings.content: No worries at all. We're happy to adjust it for FREE until it meets your expectations.
